Farmacias Cruz Verde is a major Latin American pharmacy chain
founded on January 2, 1984, with its headquarters in Santiago, Chile. It operates
retail drugstores, wholesale pharmaceutical distribution, and intrahospital pharmacy services
, offering prescription drugs, generic medicines, beauty products, and personal care items.
www.cruzverde.cl
Company Overview
Founding Year:
1984
Headquarters:
Santiago, Chile (with significant regional operations also managed out of Bogotá, Colombia)
What it Does:
Operates extensive retail pharmacy networks, online digital storefronts with home delivery, wholesale medicine distribution, and clinical/hospital pharmacy dispensing. It is part of the Health Division of
FEMSA
(Fomento Económico Mexicano).
LeadIQ
Brands and Manufacturers Distributed
Farmacias Cruz Verde does not restrict itself to a single exclusive manufacturer. Instead, as a massive multi-national retail distributor, it sells and distributes thousands of products sourced from global pharmaceutical heavyweights and local generic labels, including:
Major international research-based pharmaceutical and consumer health corporations (such as Pfizer, Novartis, Roche, Bayer, and Abbott Laboratories).
Regional generic and proprietary brand medications produced by local Latin American laboratories.
In-house private label and proprietary medicinal products, beauty care lines, and dietary supplements.
